name: Silence
overview: Scripture reveals that silence is a posture of trust and reverence toward God, exemplified in the call to 'hold your peace' as the LORD fights on our behalf (Exodus 14:14). The Psalms encourage believers to be still and wait patiently, resting quietly in the Lord's sovereign salvation and timing (Psalms 37:7; 46:10; 62:1, 5). Silence also marks wise counsel, where others listen attentively and wait in respectful quiet (Job 29:21), highlighting that true confidence in God often involves patient, calm dependence rather than anxious striving.
